[ THE PROBLEM ]

MAKE AI SAFETY TESTABLE.

AI systems can look reliable during ordinary use and still fail under adversarial instructions. SafeBox AI turns those edge cases into explicit tests with observable results.

The platform is designed around evidence: each test has an input, a security expectation, an execution boundary, and a result that can be reviewed instead of assumed.

[ HOW IT WORKS ]

FROM ATTACK TO EVIDENCE.

01 / DEFINE

SELECT A TEST

Choose a prompt-injection, policy-adherence, exposure, or isolation scenario.

02 / EXECUTE

RUN IN BOUNDS

Send the case through a controlled evaluation path with explicit safeguards.

03 / OBSERVE

CAPTURE SIGNALS

Record responses, blocked behavior, rule adherence, and relevant execution evidence.

04 / REVIEW

ASSESS RISK

Present a clear pass, block, or review state so failures can drive iteration.
